tagline: Marathons, Hyrox, zone 2 and the endless search for the perfect routine.
why: Fitness is one of the most common things people talk about: their runs, gym routines, races and gadgets. Hong Kong has a big running and gym culture, from the Standard Chartered Marathon to Hyrox races and trail ultras. Knowing the training vocabulary, the big events and current trends lets you swap tips and encouragement with anyone.

essentials.title: Cardio vs strength
essentials.body: Cardio (running, cycling, swimming) builds endurance; strength training (weights) builds muscle and bone. Most experts recommend both.

essentials.title: Race distances
essentials.body: 5K, 10K, half marathon (21.1 km) and marathon (42.2 km). Anything longer is an ultramarathon.

essentials.title: The World Marathon Majors
essentials.body: Tokyo, Boston, London, Berlin, Chicago, New York and Sydney (added in 2025). Finishing all of them earns a 'six-star' (now seven-star) medal.

essentials.title: Zone 2 and heart rate
essentials.body: Training at an easy, conversational pace (zone 2) builds aerobic fitness. Many runners do most runs slow and a few fast.

essentials.title: Hybrid fitness
essentials.body: Hyrox, a race mixing running with functional workouts, exploded worldwide, including in Hong Kong.

essentials.title: Recovery matters
essentials.body: Sleep, rest days, protein and mobility work are as important as training.

names.name: Eliud Kipchoge
names.what: Kenyan marathon legend who ran the first sub-two-hour marathon (unofficial) in 2019.

names.name: Kelvin Kiptum
names.what: Set the marathon world record of 2:00:35 in 2023; died in a car crash in 2024.

names.name: Usain Bolt
names.what: The fastest man ever; 100m world record 9.58 seconds.

names.name: Garmin
names.what: Sports watch maker loved by runners.

names.name: Hyrox
names.what: The fitness racing series that went global.

names.name: Nike / Adidas / Asics
names.what: Major running shoe brands; super shoes with carbon plates changed racing.

names.name: Peter Attia / Andrew Huberman
names.what: Popular podcasters on longevity and fitness.

names.what: Hong Kong's famous 100 km team charity hike.

now.headline: Run clubs are the new bars
now.detail: Social run clubs became a popular way to meet people.

now.headline: Hyrox boom
now.detail: Hyrox races sell out worldwide, including in Hong Kong.

now.headline: Strength for longevity
now.detail: Lifting weights for health, especially as you age, is a big trend.

now.headline: Wearables everywhere
now.detail: Garmin, Apple Watch, Whoop and Oura track everything.

now.headline: GLP-1 drugs
now.detail: Weight-loss drugs are changing diet and gym culture.

local.headline: Hong Kong Marathon
local.detail: Tens of thousands run each year; the route crosses bridges and tunnels.

local.headline: Harbourfront runs
local.detail: Popular routes: Central to Kennedy Town, Tsim Sha Tsui promenade, the flat Bowen Road fitness trail, and Tai Tam reservoirs.

local.headline: Heat and humidity
local.detail: Summer running is brutal; serious runners go early morning or at night.

local.headline: Gym chains
local.detail: Pure, Anytime Fitness and boutique studios are everywhere.

debates.question: Running: good or bad for knees?
debates.sides: Studies suggest recreational running is fine for most knees; injuries come from doing too much too soon.
